name: Caramelized Black Pepper Fish
instructions: Add the shallots and cook for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until they soften transfer them to a small bowl and set aside
Add sugar , fish sauce , and water to the skillet
Over medium heat , cook the mixture for about 5 minutes , until it starts to turn brown and there are large bubbles throughout
Sprinkle in the pepper and the cooked shallots and cook for a minute more
Add the fish and cook , turning gently with a spatula every three minutes or so , until it is coated evenly with thickened caramel sauce , and just cooked through , 8-10 minutes
Serve with steamed rice and a simple green vegetable
